puzzles.description: Pak Ali — Mamak Vendor at Toll Plaza

config.name: Pak Ali
config.greeting: Developer ya? Mau teh tarik? My nephew uses new method — an AI assistant, Kiro. Like having a smart teammate. Want LRT pass?

lines.label: Tell me about your nephew's method
lines.response: Called AIDLC. AI analyzes everything, then PROPOSES a fix. But nephew still decides. AI never goes alone. 'AI suggests, I approve.' Fast because AI does prep work.

lines.label: How is that different?
lines.response: Without Kiro: gather everything yourself, design yourself, build step by step. Nothing wrong! But takes time. With Kiro: AI gathers and proposes. You think and approve. Same quality — less time.

lines.label: Give me the LRT pass
lines.response: First: for THIS crash — full end-to-end redesign... or just fix what broke? If scope is focused, the AI can be laser-precise.

lines.label: Just fix what broke — focused scope
lines.response: Exactly! Adaptive thinking. Here — LRT pass. Express lane has Kiro ready. Selamat jalan!

lines.label: I need to review everything fully
lines.response: Also good! Thorough is respectable. Standard lane ahead. If you change mind later — there's an on-ramp from the overpass.

state_lines.label: Thanks for the pass!
state_lines.response: No problem! Remember: the AI proposes, YOU decide. It's still your fix — just with a very smart assistant.

hints: Talk to Pak Ali and choose 'focused scope' to receive the LRT pass

config.name: Fellow Commuter
config.greeting: You're the GoLancar dev? Ha — I was in your seat last month. Different app, same panic. Kiro — the AI assistant — saved me.

lines.label: What was it like?
lines.response: It proposed a plan in seconds. I said no to half of it, fixed the scope, approved the rest. Felt less like coding alone and more like leading a small team.

lines.label: Any advice?
lines.response: Give it the right context and nothing else. And never skip your own review — the AI is fast, but you're the one accountable.

config.name: Kiro
config.greeting: I'm Kiro, your AI assistant. I've broken the fix into 3 parallel Bolts. But I need YOUR approval before anything runs.

lines.label: What are the 3 Bolts?
lines.response: Bolt 1: fix the core issue (2h). Bolt 2: add the safety net (2h). Bolt 3: verify under load (1h). In parallel: 2 hours total — not 5 sequential.

lines.label: Why need my approval?
lines.response: I propose, you decide. Always. I might suggest wrong scope, miss a constraint only YOU know, or over-engineer. The audit logs every proposal and every decision.

lines.label: What if your proposal is wrong?
lines.response: Reject it! I'll re-propose with your feedback. The loop: I propose → you review → approve or redirect. Always your call.

lines.label: What about quality?
lines.response: Two machine layers first: sensors catch issues, a reviewer agent evaluates logic. Then YOU — the human gate. It's called the dual-loop.

lines.label: Who else is on the team?
lines.response: 14 specialist agents — security, architecture, QA. They resolve issues among themselves and only escalate decisions to you. You lead a team, not babysit one.

config.learning_card: 🧠 Adaptive Composition — Not every task needs you, and not everything belongs. AI runs the routine (inner loop), you make the judgment calls (outer loop), and you skip what this fix doesn't need.
